        Policy workflow instructions

        Create a reviewed policy JSON, run crawlledger policy simulate, inspect every risk, then render a draft. CrawlLedger never applies or reloads server configuration.

        Privacy and methodology

        Crawler identity is claimed from User-Agent and is not DNS-verified.

        Sanitized identifiers remain linkable within one HMAC key scope.

        Allocated cost is proportional attribution, not an invoice or guaranteed saving.

        Stable pseudonyms, timestamps, routes, crawler claims and referer hosts retain correlation and re-identification risk.
